description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Samwise the Stouthearted.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Samwise the Stouthearted from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pyramid of the Pantheon
uses.cardState: with three or more brick counters on it
